notes.text: The first paragraph says that the contemplated model for S T-top plus/minus would have to be large enough to contain all chords, allowing deformations, and remarks on its size. The second expects that, alongside the desired S T D-top model, one can determine models for Pi-one(X,R) and their functorial dependence on (X,R). This is a proposed construction programme; the page supplies no construction or proof.

The capital Pi with subscript 1 is read in the usual fundamental-groupoid sense for a space X with designated points R. This is interpretive background for the final clause, not an independently proved claim on this sheet. The capital Pi, the numeric 1, both pair entries and the parentheses were checked together in the complete formula.

H appends a heading beginning Découpage de cartes en “pantalons” généralisés, followed by its own explanation associating that title with a cover. No such heading is present anywhere on this supplied leaf. The appended material is treated as a source-page mismatch and is excluded from both the transcription and the count of current-leaf reading corrections. No other leaf was consulted.

Both category superscripts are plus/minus. In the first occurrence the plus and its lower minus are separate; in the later occurrence the upright reaches between the two bars, producing an I-like form. The apparent possibility of a plain plus at first view was settled by the full formula crop; neither witness needs a correction there.

The source writes singular le modèle in the main clause and plural modèles in the later insertion. The word desire has no visible acute accent, and no independent comma follows it. The two underline segments beneath toutes and les cordes are retained. The curved attachment around modèles des points into the gap after the live des and before Pi-one; it does not cancel either des.

The head numeral is 21 and the pale lower folio is 64. The lower annotation is assigned to an unnamed hand with attribution uncertain. Apart from that folio, the lower prepared half is blank; fine incidental sheet traces are not treated as text or diagrams.

All four unequal boxes were reviewed after the independent TSV was frozen. The inserted parenthesis remains moyennant deformations, the lower noun remains foulee, and the article before it stays la/le. The compressed verb after qu'on is reopened as desire/deduit; the mathematics of obtaining a model does not decide its letters. The insertion leader supplies the attachment of modeles des, not an additional mathematical diagram. No model-existence assertion was proved. This audit adds a certainty qualification, not a new material witness-error row.
